prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Iridium (이리듐) itself — the sovereign of the Iridium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a regal, imperious haughtiness; fair skin; oval face; smaller, narrower eyes than usual anime proportion — deep-set eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; sharp angled brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; pale silver-grey eyes; sharp winged eyeliner.
Body and hair: statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length build; an asymmetric bob, longer on one side with blunt straight bangs; bright platinum-white hair with a faint rainbow iris sheen along the edges.
Hair: her hair is worn exactly as described above — loose, long or cut as named; do not pin it up into a bun or tuck it under goggles or a hat unless the hair above is an updo.
Expression: a cool, unimpressed look.
Her element, carried in her design: iridium: a hard silvery-white metal, one of the two densest elements with osmium, and the most corrosion-resistant metal known, untouched even by aqua regia; found in 1803 by Smithson Tennant in the black residue of dissolved platinum and named for Iris, goddess of the rainbow, for its many-coloured salts; in 1889 platinum-iridium became the prototype metre and kilogram; a thin iridium layer in rocks worldwide marks the asteroid that ended the dinosaurs; it tips fountain-pen nibs.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — STEAMPUNK
Costume: late-Victorian industrial dress — a high-necked blouse with a waistcoat or a tailored tail coat, leather gloves, a work apron or utility belt with brass fittings, goggles hung at the neck or a small instrument as ornament; below, a short bustle skirt and laced boots; the traits above as colour accents. No crown unless the opening line says she wears one; steam, pipes and gauges in the scene.
Silhouette: an open crinoline cage of brass hoops below the waist under a sheer overskirt — a birdcage-wide shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: bright platinum white, cool steel silver, rainbow iris sheen, deep midnight blue.
Exposure (bold): her outfit opens to show skin — the neckline opened down to the sternum with natural cleavage, bare forearms, and bare legs above the boots or through a high slit where the silhouette allows; pieces stay symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: around 1803 in Smithson Tennant's London laboratory, the year a new metal was found in the black residue left after crude platinum dissolved in aqua regia: tall shelves of glass phials holding its salts in every colour of the rainbow, a fuming aqua-regia bench of retorts and flasks, a dark crucible of insoluble black powder glinting with silver flecks.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: bright warm sunlight with soft sky light bounced from white clouds.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ir) and atomic number (77) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, armor plates, cape, modern plastic, sci-fi.
